page.overview:
Who is Blackheart?

Blackheart is a veteran mercenary general, famed for his expeditions to the Far East and the Lizardmen temple-cities of Lustria. He is capable of leading armies composed of many different mortal races -- all united by their thirst for gold and glory.

Blackheart began his career as a young mercenary captain, leading armies that counted Orcs and Hobgoblins, Men, Elves and Dwarfs amongst their ranks. In this early period, he travelled to the Far East and took part in the assault upon Nan Chu, where a hundred thousand perished upon the field, and then in the ensuing Terror of Wang, during which ten times as many died. It may have been during this time that he learnt not to trust the treachery of Hobgoblin units, barring them from ever serving under his banner again.

Over his long and glorious career, Blackheart's hair turned grey and his body became a criss-cross of livid scars - badges of bloody battle, cruel captivity and occasional inattentiveness. He wore an eye-patch where an Orc blade had gouged out his eye, and he thought it rather fetching. Now he was 'the general', the man whose word drove armies over the salty seas and to the ends of the earth. He had also gained ample experience in handling fractious mercenary captains under his command, sometimes playing them against each other to maintain order.

Nonetheless, true power had always eluded him. Treasures so desperately won had been all too easily lost. Knowing this could well be his last chance, Blackheart led an expedition of the Dogs of War (including Halflings, Orcs, Dwarf Thunderers, and Ogres) to assault a temple-city. There, his forces won a resounding victory over the Lizardmen defenders, and he gave them three days of unrestrained pillage in accordance to the law of battle.
